target.description: Measured liquid-droplet diameter of a free-floating heptane droplet at times after the cutoff, as an unconditional predictive distribution over the droplet's state (hot flame, cool flame, no flame), plus the cumulative incidence of the end of the hot-flame phase.
excludes: flame temperature, soot, species or radiant emission
a calibrated posterior: the spread is an assumed scenario distribution

features.name: c_logd0
features.transform: ln(sqrt(q0) / norm.d_ref_m); q0 = mean(D^2) over the head window advanced to t = 0 with the population rate at w = 0 @2

features.name: x_exc
features.transform: c_logd0 - N_crit(c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp) = ln(D0 / D_crit) @2

features.name: s
features.transform: t * norm.k_ref_m2_s / q0 with t in seconds since the time origin (igniter energised) @1

features.name: e_late
features.transform: clamp(ln(max(K_obs, enc.k_floor_m2_s) / K_model), -enc.e_clip[0], enc.e_clip[1]); K_obs = finite difference of window means of D^2 (mid -> tail); K_model = harmonic Simpson mean of the hot-flame population rate over the same interval @2

features.name: e_early
features.transform: as e_late for head -> mid; both equal the head -> tail value when the mid window is empty @2

features.name: r_late
features.transform: K_obs / K_model of the late finite difference, unclamped (reported) @2

features.name: r_end
features.transform: K_obs / K_model of the finite difference between the last two end windows (enc.end_frac of the prefix each), unclamped: the state evidence @3

features.name: g_span
features.transform: ln((mean time of tail window - mean time of head window) / 1 s) @1

features.name: flame_seen
features.transform: 1 when the last positive flame diameter of either camera that has two more within fl.gap_s before it lies within fl.gap_s of the cutoff, 0 when the cameras recorded the flame (fl.min_points positive values after fl.t_min_s) and no longer show it; absent when they did not record it @1

tensors.name: rate.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the hot-flame rate network ln(K_h/K_ref); row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_logd0, w, s).

tensors.name: rate.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the hot-flame rate network ln(K_h/K_ref) (hinge positions).

tensors.name: rate.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the hot-flame rate network ln(K_h/K_ref) (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: rate.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the hot-flame rate network ln(K_h/K_ref) in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: rate.b0
tensors.description: ln(K_h/K_ref) at x = 0: air, 1e5 Pa, D0 = 2 mm, w = 0, s = 0, before hinge terms.

tensors.name: crit.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the critical-diameter law ln(D_crit/D_ref); row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp).

tensors.name: crit.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the critical-diameter law ln(D_crit/D_ref) (hinge positions).

tensors.name: crit.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the critical-diameter law ln(D_crit/D_ref) (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: crit.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the critical-diameter law ln(D_crit/D_ref) in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: crit.b0
tensors.description: ln(D_crit/D_ref) in air at 1e5 Pa, before hinge terms: droplets larger than D_crit lose the hot flame to radiation.

tensors.name: class.kappa
tensors.description: Sharpness of the radiative class in x_exc = ln(D0/D_crit).

tensors.name: class.bias
tensors.description: Logit of the radiative class at D0 = D_crit.

tensors.name: diff.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the diffusive-extinction law logit(w_D); row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_logd0, x_exc).

tensors.name: diff.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the diffusive-extinction law logit(w_D) (hinge positions).

tensors.name: diff.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the diffusive-extinction law logit(w_D) (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: diff.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the diffusive-extinction law logit(w_D) in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: diff.b0
tensors.description: logit of the median burn progress at diffusive extinction at x = 0, before hinge terms.

tensors.name: diff.sharp
tensors.description: a_D: Gompertz sharpness of diffusive extinction in burn progress.

tensors.name: rad.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the radiative-extinction law ln(s_R); row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_logd0, x_exc).

tensors.name: rad.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the radiative-extinction law ln(s_R) (hinge positions).

tensors.name: rad.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the radiative-extinction law ln(s_R) (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: rad.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the radiative-extinction law ln(s_R) in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: rad.b0
tensors.description: ln of the median diffusion clock at radiative extinction at x = 0, before hinge terms.

tensors.name: rad.sharp
tensors.description: a_R: Gompertz sharpness of radiative extinction in s/s_R.

tensors.name: cool.p.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the cool-flame onset logit after a radiative extinction; row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_logd0, x_exc).

tensors.name: cool.p.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the cool-flame onset logit after a radiative extinction (hinge positions).

tensors.name: cool.p.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the cool-flame onset logit after a radiative extinction (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: cool.p.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the cool-flame onset logit after a radiative extinction in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: cool.p.b0
tensors.description: Logit of a cool flame following radiative extinction at x = 0, before hinge terms.

tensors.name: cool.k.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the cool-flame rate law ln(K_c/K_ref); row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_logd0).

tensors.name: cool.k.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the cool-flame rate law ln(K_c/K_ref) (hinge positions).

tensors.name: cool.k.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the cool-flame rate law ln(K_c/K_ref) (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: cool.k.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the cool-flame rate law ln(K_c/K_ref) in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: cool.k.b0
tensors.description: ln(K_c/K_ref) at x = 0, before hinge terms.

tensors.name: cool.d.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the cool-flame extinction-diameter law ln(D_ce/D_ref); row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_logd0).

tensors.name: cool.d.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the cool-flame extinction-diameter law ln(D_ce/D_ref) (hinge positions).

tensors.name: cool.d.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the cool-flame extinction-diameter law ln(D_ce/D_ref) (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: cool.d.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the cool-flame extinction-diameter law ln(D_ce/D_ref) in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: cool.d.b0
tensors.description: ln(D_ce/D_ref) at x = 0, before hinge terms.

tensors.name: cool.d.sd
tensors.description: Assumed sd of ln D_ce between droplets of one condition.

tensors.name: post.cool_scale
tensors.description: Multiplier of post.k_hot after a cool flame (the surroundings are cooler than after a hot flame).

tensors.name: post.k_inf
tensors.description: Long-time d(D^2)/dt magnitude of an extinguished droplet of D = D_ref.

tensors.name: post.k_hot
tensors.description: Extra d(D^2)/dt magnitude right after extinction of a droplet of D = D_ref (the gas is still hot); decays with tau_e.

tensors.name: post.tau0_s
tensors.description: Decay time of post.k_hot for a droplet extinguished at D = D_ref.

tensors.name: post.size_exp
tensors.description: Exponent of (q_e/q_ref) in the long-time evaporation rate.

tensors.name: post.hot_exp
tensors.description: Exponent of (q_e/q_ref) in the amplitude of the extra evaporation right after extinction.

tensors.name: post.tau_exp
tensors.description: Exponent of (q_e/q_ref) in the decay time of the extra evaporation.

tensors.name: enc.gain_w
tensors.description: Weights of the gain logit on (g_span, g_count, g_progress).

tensors.name: enc.gain_b
tensors.description: Bias of the gain logit; gain = sigmoid(logit).

tensors.name: enc.mix
tensors.description: Weights of (e_late, e_early) in the run's log-rate innovation.

tensors.name: enc.e_clip
tensors.description: Clamp of the log-rate innovations: (below, above) the population rate.

tensors.name: enc.cool_gain
tensors.description: Share of the end-rate innovation against the cool-flame law that a cool flame burning at the cutoff keeps as its run offset.

tensors.name: filt.sd_hot
tensors.description: Assumed sd of the end-rate ratio r = K_obs/K_h of a droplet inside a hot flame (inside a cool flame: times K_c/K_h).

tensors.name: filt.sd_evap
tensors.description: Assumed sd of the end-rate ratio r = K_obs/K_h of a droplet without a flame.

tensors.name: filt.l_floor
tensors.description: Density added to every state's likelihood of r, so that an absurd r returns the prior.

tensors.name: filt.gain_w
tensors.description: Weights of the state-evidence exponent logit on (g_span, g_count, g_progress).

tensors.name: filt.gain_b
tensors.description: Bias of the state-evidence exponent logit; exponent = sigmoid(logit).

tensors.name: rob.eps_r
tensors.description: Probability that the radiative clock of this atmosphere is not the law's: weight of a clock with the same median s_R and survival 1 / (1 + s / s_R) in the survival of the radiative class (0: the law alone).

tensors.name: fl.trust
tensors.description: Probability that the flame cameras are right about the hot flame at the cutoff; the state at the cutoff is this weight on their verdict and the rest on the diameter's (0: the cameras are not read).

tensors.name: fl.t_min_s
tensors.description: Flame diameters before this time are not used (igniter glare and the ignition flash).

tensors.name: fl.gap_s
tensors.description: The hot flame counts as seen at the cutoff when the last positive flame diameter that has two more within this time before it lies at most this long before the cutoff.

tensors.name: fl.min_points
tensors.description: Fewest positive flame diameters after fl.t_min_s for the cameras to count as having recorded this flame.

tensors.name: fl.evap_mix
tensors.description: For a droplet whose flame the cameras lost before the cutoff: weight of the flame's heat left according to the time since it was lost, against the estimate from the end rate.

tensors.name: unc.s_pop
tensors.description: Assumed sd of a run's ln K around the population law before any prefix evidence.

tensors.name: unc.s_floor
tensors.description: Assumed sd of ln K that no prefix removes.

tensors.name: unc.sigma_d
tensors.description: Assumed sd of one diameter measurement around the latent diameter (level error included).

tensors.name: unc.sigma_frame
tensors.description: Assumed frame-to-frame sd of the diameter (what a finite difference of window means sees).

tensors.name: haz.log_disruption
tensors.description: ln of the constant disruption hazard of a burning droplet (reported, does not change the diameter).

tensors.name: norm.d_ref_m
tensors.description: Reference diameter of c_logd0, D_crit and D_ce.

tensors.name: norm.p_ref_pa
tensors.description: Reference pressure of c_logp.

tensors.name: norm.k_ref_m2_s
tensors.description: Reference burning-rate constant and clock rate.

tensors.name: norm.n_ref
tensors.description: Reference number of prefix points of g_count.

tensors.name: enc.window_frac
tensors.description: Head, mid and tail windows each span this fraction of the prefix duration.

tensors.name: enc.end_frac
tensors.description: The end rate is the finite difference between the means of D^2 over the last two windows of the prefix, each spanning this fraction of its duration; the level at the cutoff is carried from the last of them.

tensors.name: enc.k_floor_m2_s
tensors.description: Floor of an observed rate before its logarithm.

tensors.name: enc.w_ref
tensors.description: Progress at which g_progress saturates.

tensors.name: enc.min_points
tensors.description: Fewest valid prefix diameters for a forecast.

tensors.name: gate.growth_tol
tensors.description: A diameter is dropped when later prefix values of D^2 exceed it by more than this fraction.

tensors.name: gate.min_later
tensors.description: Number of later contradicting values that drops a diameter.

tensors.name: gate.k_max_m2_s
tensors.description: Largest d(D^2)/dt magnitude any flame of these experiments produces (twice the fastest measured rate): a later value below what this allows contradicts an earlier one, and the level is not carried to the cutoff faster than this.

tensors.name: num.dt_s
tensors.description: RK4 step of the hot phase (uniform grid from the cutoff).

tensors.name: num.bin_s
tensors.description: Width of the extinction-time bins the mixture atoms are built from.

tensors.name: num.d_min_m
tensors.description: Support floor: the model stops at this diameter.

tensors.name: num.t_valid_s
tensors.description: Model horizon since the time origin.

tensors.name: num.z_step
tensors.description: Spacing of the scenario nodes of z.

tensors.name: num.z_count
tensors.description: Number of scenario nodes of z, centred on 0.

tensors.name: num.ce_step
tensors.description: Spacing of the scenario nodes of the cool-flame extinction diameter.

tensors.name: num.ce_count
tensors.description: Number of scenario nodes of the cool-flame extinction diameter.

notes: Prefix observations: liquid_diameter, valid, positive, 0 <= t <= cutoff, first of equal time stamps, then the validity gate (a value is dropped when at least gate.min_later later prefix values of D^2 contradict it: larger by more than gate.growth_tol, since a droplet does not grow, or smaller than gate.k_max_m2_s allows in the time between). Level at the cutoff: mean of D^2 over the last end window carried to the cutoff along the end rate (finite difference of the last two end windows) limited to [0, min(gate.k_max_m2_s, twice the mid -> tail rate)] (no weight enters it). Survival of the radiative class at clock s: S_R(s) = (1 - rob.eps_r) exp(-Lambda_R(s)) + rob.eps_r / (1 + s / s_R), in the prior at the cutoff and, divided by its value at the cutoff, in the forecast. State probabilities at the cutoff: prior from the extinction laws at the observed progress and clock, times (N(r_end; mean_state, sd_state) + filt.l_floor)^g, normalised, g = sigmoid(filt.gain_b + filt.gain_w . (g_span, g_count, g_progress)); means 1 (hot), K_c/K_h (cool), k_evap/K_h (no flame, half of the post-extinction transient left); sds from filt.sd_hot, filt.sd_evap and the finite-difference noise implied by unc.sigma_frame. Run offset of the hot flame: gain times the clamped mid -> tail and head -> mid innovations; of a cool flame burning at the cutoff: enc.cool_gain * g * clamped ln(end rate / K_c). A droplet without a flame at the cutoff evaporates with the transient amplitude its end rate shows (weight g) or half of post.k_hot (weight 1 - g). Flame cameras (fl.trust > 0, and the prefix holds at least fl.min_points positive uv_flame_diameter or visible_flame_diameter values in [fl.t_min_s, cutoff]): t_last is the last of those times that has two more within fl.gap_s before it; the flame is seen when cutoff - t_last <= fl.gap_s. The state probabilities after the rate evidence, s, become fl.trust * v + (1 - fl.trust) * s with v = (1, 0, 0) when the flame is seen and v = (0, s_cool, s_none) / (s_cool + s_none) otherwise (the law's cool-flame probability at the cutoff in place of that ratio when s_cool + s_none = 0). When the flame is not seen the transient amplitude of a droplet without a flame is fl.evap_mix * exp(-(cutoff - t_last) / tau_e) + (1 - fl.evap_mix) * (the end-rate estimate). Nothing else is read from the flame diameters. Hot phase: RK4 on a uniform grid of num.dt_s from the cutoff, linear interpolation to the forecast times; extinction mass collected in bins of num.bin_s; everything after a transition is closed form. Scenario nodes z_k = (k - (n-1)/2) * z_step with weights proportional to exp(-z^2/2), for the rate and, independently, for ln D_ce. Predictive quantiles: quantiles of the mixture of Gaussians of sd unc.sigma_d centred on the mixture atoms (atoms pooled on a grid of sigma_d/4; each quantile by bisection of the monotone mixture CDF). Latent quantiles: step quantiles of the atoms. Uncertainty kind: assumed_noise.
